messages:
nina: Quick design check: propose a small bulk-check endpoint for console dashboards to avoid N auth calls when loading tiles. POST /v1/bulk_check with a list of (user, resource, action) -> returns map of results.

ravi: Love it. Two constraints: (1) must preserve auditability (we need per-check logs), (2) don't let a single tenant blow up the check service.

clare: For auditability we can emit one log per item but batch them into the same trace/span for correlation. For protection, rate-limit and enforce per-tenant max batch size (e.g., 200 checks).

nina: Perf plan: keep per-worker LRU (30s) + shared memcached; bulk endpoint will consult cache and only evaluate misses. That keeps p99 low.

ravi: Also add a TTL sweep heuristic: if >80% of batch items are cache misses, do a background precompute to warm common prefixes.

clare: Security note: bulk payload must be signed by console frontend via internal JWT so external callers cannot abuse it. Also include tenant id header for quota accounting.

ops-bot: created alert: CONSOLE_BULK_CHECK_ERROR_RATE (P2) on: (sum(rate(console_bulk_check_errors_total[10m])) / sum(rate(console_bulk_check_requests_total[10m]))) > 0.001

nina: Nice. Migration plan: shadow mode where console sends bulk_check and still does per-item checks; compare diffs for 48h. If mismatch_rate < 0.01% rollout 1% -> 10% -> 100%.

ravi: Tests: replay last 7 days of console auth logs against bulk path; add fuzz for ordering and dedup.

clare: I'll draft the API spec and security checklist. Will @you all on the PR. Closing thread.
